name: Clean water
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text:
You do one of the following: Create Water.
You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container.
Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.
Destroy Water.
You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range.
Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.
You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.

authored_operations: Create up to 10 gallons in an open container within range; each slot level above 1 adds 10 gallons, or increases the alternative rain/fog Cube side by 5 feet.

Destroy mode removes actual water in an open container rather than granting a negative inventory object. Rain extinguishes exposed flames in the source Cube; fog removal/rain stay world effects. No created-water expiry is specified.

additional_rules_owner.rule: Creates 30 gallons of fresh clean water on ground or in containers within range. Its food spoils after 24 hours; source does not apply that expiry to water.
